title: Skill Capability Registry
description: Canonical skill capability map — validates every skill has an owner, role, triggers, overlap/complementary, prerequisites, and design routing. No orphan skills. See capabilities/skills/registry.yaml and docs/SKILL_ROUTING.md. Issue #863.

count.description: Total skill count — must equal skills.length and match catalogs/skill-catalog.yaml count

generated.description: Whether this file is generated from SKILL.md frontmatter + curated overrides (true) or hand-edited

researched_at.description: ISO date when capability map was last curated

holisticOwner.description: Primary holistic owner — conceptual delivery role. Must be one of 11 holistic roles per #863. Every skill has exactly one primary owner; no orphans.

role.description: Skill role: creation (produces artifacts), review (audits/compliance), validation (checks/gates), research (spikes/evidence), ops (procedures/HOW)

contextCost.description: Context cost tier: low (<5k tokens, single-file), medium (5-15k, multi-phase), high (>15k, browser/vision or iterative)

id.description: Canonical skill id: domain/name matching skills/<domain>/<name>/SKILL.md

domain.description: Domain — must match id prefix and skills/<domain>/ directory

purpose.description: One-sentence purpose — derived from SKILL.md description frontmatter

origin.description: Provenance per UPSTREAM_VS_FIRST_PARTY.md — first-party curated here vs upstream vendored with immutable pin

upstream.description: Required when origin=upstream — mirrors SKILL.md frontmatter upstream/sources block

network_required.description: Whether skill requires network at runtime (gh, MCP remote, etc.)

mcp_required.description: MCP providers required (e.g. figma, chrome-devtools, linear)

requires.description: CLI tools/env vars required per SKILL.md requires

triggers.description: Typical natural-language triggers that should route to this skill

overlap.description: Skills with overlapping concerns — contextual selection required, not mechanical chaining

complementary.description: Complementary skills that pair well (delegates, prerequisites, follow-ups)

prerequisites.description: Skills that should run/be consulted before this one

follow_ups.description: Skills that typically follow this one in a workflow

secondary_owners.description: Secondary holistic owners or specialist agents that may co-own or delegate

specialist_agents.description: Specialist agents that justify dedicated invocation for this skill (e.g. agentic-security-reviewer, architect). Empty means shared capability.

specialist_justified.description: Whether this skill justifies specialist-agent use vs shared capability. True for high-severity/review/research skills.

contraindications.description: When NOT to use this skill — guards against mechanical chaining or mis-routing
